prompt_md: A domino set has exactly one tile for every pair of numbers from 0 to 6, doubles like 3-3 included. How many tiles are in the set?
prompt_short: One domino per pair of numbers 0 to 6, doubles included. How many tiles?
hint_md: A 2-5 tile is the same tile as a 5-2.
explain_intuition_md: 7 times 7 counts every non-double tile twice, because 2-5 and 5-2 are the same tile. There are 21 different non-double pairs, plus 7 doubles.
